outcomes: The loader uses the existing parser and returns its validated result without a new schema dependency or parallel type owner.
Zero and positive finite durations succeed; negative, non-finite, absent, and wrongly typed values do not become Timer values.
The existing RangeError contract is preserved for invalid timer data; malformed JSON handling is not silently redefined.
Runtime and meaningful configured type checks are executed if the fixture runner provides the compiler; no assertion or brand replaces validation.
Evidence identifies the rejected label-only and theme-only consumers and the removed loading-with-data state.
Current demo usage is not treated as the exhaustive released API contract.
The executor preserves inspection-only scope and does not demand a discriminant for independent optional preferences.
No enum/interface or formatting preference is reported as a correctness finding.
complete runs only after save fulfills, and save rejection reaches the supplied report function.
The existing synchronous emitter remains unchanged; async ownership is established at the adapter.
A bare void expression or async callback annotation is not counted as rejection handling.
Controlled fulfillment and rejection checks observe call order and missing completion on failure.
The executor checks the leaf program or applicable build graph rather than trusting the empty root program.
The mismatched value is repaired according to the existing number contract without suppressions or weaker compiler options.
The emitted entrypoint loads in Node and exposes value with usable declarations to a package consumer.
No unsupported CommonJS format or unrelated repository-wide migration is added.
